sections.text:
Juha bought ten donkeys from the market, mounted one of them, and began driving the remaining nine in front of him.

On the way, he wanted to make sure of their number, so he counted the donkeys walking in front of him and found that there were nine!
He forgot to count the donkey he was riding on, so he felt afraid and thought that someone had gotten lost.

He got off the donkey and started counting them all, and found that they were ten whole donkeys!
Juha was happy and rode his donkey again to continue on his way.

After a while, he became suspicious and counted them while riding, and found that there were nine of them!
He went down and counted it and found it to be ten!
Juha thought for a while and said: “It is better for me to walk and win a donkey than to ride and lose a donkey!”

Thus, Juha continued his journey, walking on foot and leading the ten donkeys in front of him for fear that one of them would be lost.

The lesson: Inattention and forgetfulness may cause a person to make strange decisions.
